name: medqa_s1_v1_r1_strict_late
responses: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.
I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.
I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.

The walking difficulty and coordination problems are the main issues. I do not have chest pain or other major symptoms besides the neurological problems. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.
